headline: 5 children died with measles symptoms in 24 hours
summary: Over 1,300 people showed symptoms of the virus in a single day, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: Five children died with measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Monday.
During the same period, 35 cases of measles were confirmed and 1,307 people showed symptoms of the disease.
The deaths occurred in Dhaka, Sylhet, Chittagong, and Khulna, with two children dying in the capital city.
According to DGHS data, 1,097 people have died with measles symptoms since March 15, while 104 children have died from confirmed measles cases.
The total number of deaths associated with measles and its symptoms in the country has now reached 1,201.
caption:
5 children died in just 24 hours. Over 1,300 people are showing symptoms of measles.

Five children died with measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Monday.

During the same period, 35 cases of measles were confirmed and 1,307 people showed symptoms of the disease.

The deaths occurred in Dhaka, Sylhet, Chittagong, and Khulna, with two children dying in the capital city.

According to DGHS data, 1,097 people have died with measles symptoms since March 15, while 104 children have died from confirmed measles cases.

The total number of deaths associated with measles and its symptoms in the country has now reached 1,201.
